task: Fix a black background on the selected Datasource Type Autocomplete dropdown item after the Description textarea is clicked and the dropdown is reopened.

key_reasoning.reason: Fix lands in the Autocomplete component's ptPreset.ts pass-through styling (and possibly the global primeReactPtOptions in src/constants/theme.ts) — a shared, reusable form primitive under src/components/form/, not a page-local file, so a change here is scoped as touching core shared UI utilities even though only one interaction bug is being fixed.

Root cause is an established, well-documented pattern (PrimeReact pt overrides plus Tailwind semantic theme tokens per theme-management.md), so novelty is low, but no test exists for DataSourceTypeSelector or for the specific cross-field focus/blur interaction sequence the acceptance criteria describe — that defensive-test gap pushes risk up one notch.

red_flags_applied: Component Scope bumped from S to M: fix touches Autocomplete, a shared/reusable form primitive (core shared utility), via its ptPreset.ts pass-through styling module.

Technical Risk bumped from S to M: acceptance criteria include an edge case (no regression to other dropdowns / specific focus-then-reopen sequence) with no existing test template covering that cross-field focus interaction.
